description: This is a Python Flask web application for enhanced Indian license plate recognition. It includes license plate detection, OCR processing, database integration with MongoDB, and web routes for vehicle management and real-time detection visualization.

classes.name: IndianPlateDetector
classes.description: Class responsible for detecting Indian license plates using contour analysis and cascade classifiers, and performing OCR with enhanced preprocessing and validation.

methods.name: load_vehicle_database
methods.description: Loads vehicle data from MongoDB into a local dictionary for quick access.

methods.name: process_video
methods.description: Captures video frames, detects license plates, performs OCR, and streams annotated frames for real-time display.
